contact.summary1: I am a Systems Engineer with a Master's Degree in Integrated Management Systems and a Specialization in Teaching and Pedagogy, with over 10 years of experience in teaching and managing technology projects. My career spans roles such as university lecturer, project director, and software development specialist, with a strong focus on Cloud Computing (AWS/Azure), algorithms, web development, databases, and project management.
contact.summary2: I have worked as a lecturer at several prestigious institutions, including Jala University, Tecnalia Colombia, and Universitaria de Colombia, teaching key subjects in systems engineering and software development. Additionally, I served as Project Director at International Data Information and Consulting SAS, leading multidisciplinary teams and managing frontend development, design, and system administration projects using agile methodologies such as Scrum.
contact.summary3: My focus on education is complemented by a strong background in quality management and applied ergonomics, which I have implemented in both academic and industry settings. My experience also includes roles in database management, systems auditing, and data analysis in the healthcare sector.
